plain.li: [first] You're the herd now, {PET_nameDef}, so keep them together.
[first] They follow you already, {PET_nameDef}, I've seen it.
[line] Your mother led them, {PET_nameDef}, and now it's you.
[line] Same look as the old one, {PET_nameDef}.
[new] Well, {PET_nameDef}, it seems it's you they follow now.
Lead them well, {PET_nameDef}.

warm.li: You've a herd to look after now, {PET_nameDef}, and so have I.

blunt.li: You lead, {PET_nameDef}, the rest follow, simple.

cold.li: The herd will follow you, {PET_nameDef}, as long as you don't lead them anywhere foolish.

plain.li: There's {PET_nameDef} again, down by the trees.
[predator] {PET_nameDef}'s watching us from the trees again.
[predator,feared] Everyone in, {PET_nameDef}'s about.
[grazer] {PET_nameDef} is on the far meadow again, bold as you like.
[fed] {PET_nameDef}'s come for its supper, by the look of it.
[fed] It knows the time of day better than I do, that {PET_nameDef}.
[watched] Still here, {PET_nameDef}, same as every day.
[child] Look, look, it's {PET_nameDef}!
[child,feared] {PET_nameDef} won't come near the wall, will it?
[pokemon] {PET_nameDef}'s back at the edge of the fields.
[pokemon,thief] Count the sacks, {PET_nameDef}'s about.
[pokemon,fed] {PET_nameDef} knows when supper is better than we do.
[pokemon,shiny] Look at the color on {PET_nameDef} in this light.
[pokemon,child] {PET_nameDef}, come here, I've got a berry!
[pokemon,catch] One good throw and {PET_nameDef} is ours.

gloomy.li: [predator] One day {PET_nameDef} won't stop at the trees.

cold.li: [predator] That animal is too used to us.

plain.li: [first] The herd has a leader: {PET_nameDef}, the old {KIND}. The others go where {PET_nameDef} goes, and have for a while; today we gave it the name.
[line] {PET_nameDef} leads the herd now, of the old leader's own blood. I'd have picked the same.
[new] The herd follows {PET_nameDef} now. A new line, and we'll see what it makes of the herd.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} leads them now. I stood at the pens a long while this evening, just watching them settle around it.

blunt.li: New leader. {PET_nameDef}. The herd knows it, so we might as well.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef}, head of the herd! Named and crowned at the pens with a bucket of feed.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} is slowing. The herd still follows, but at {PET_nameDef}'s pace now, and I think this is the old leader's last season.
I sat with {PET_nameDef} at the pens tonight. Gray at the muzzle, slow to rise. A good leader, and not much longer, I think.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef}'s last season, I'm nearly sure. I'll make it a good one.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} is old. Won't see another spring. The herd will need a new one.

gloomy.li: Everything I love in that herd is getting old, {PET_nameDef} first.

plain.li: {PET_nameDef} is gone, and the herd stood about the pens all morning not knowing where to go. Nor did I.
We lost {PET_nameDef} today, the one the herd followed. The others will sort out who leads them. I'm not ready to.

warm.li: Goodbye, {PET_nameDef}. The herd was yours, and you kept it well.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} dead. Old age. The herd needs a new leader by the week's end.

plain.li: The first calf of spring, {PET_nameDef}, born this morning to {OTHER_nameDef}. I went down to the pens to look and got no work done before noon.
Spring's first: {PET_nameDef}, a young {KIND}, on its legs within the hour. I stood by it like it was the first ever born.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef}, the first of spring. I held my breath until it stood, and then I laughed out loud.

cheerful.li: First calf of the year and it's a beauty, {PET_nameDef}! I stood at the pens grinning like a fool.

blunt.li: First young of the spring. {PET_nameDef}. Healthy. Went to look, as if I'd never seen one.

plain.li: [won] {PET_nameDef} against {OTHER_nameDef}'s Pokémon at the trainers' fire, half the colony watching, and mine came out on top. Nobody hurt, everybody shouting.
[lost] {PET_nameDef} lost the show at the trainers' fire to {OTHER_nameDef}'s Pokémon, fair and square. I saw where it went wrong. We'll practise.
[won,rematch] The rematch, and this time {PET_nameDef} took it. {OTHER_nameDef} shook my hand and said next season.
[lost,rematch] The rematch went to {OTHER_nameDef} again. {PET_nameDef} fought well. I'm starting to think it's me.

warm.li: [won] {PET_nameDef} won the show, and ran straight back to me afterward as if I'd done something.

cheerful.li: [won] We won the show at the trainers' fire! {PET_nameDef} is getting an extra supper and I'm getting no sleep.

blunt.li: [lost] Lost the show. {OTHER_nameDef}'s is higher level. Next time.

plain.li: [predator] The {KIND} that has been hanging about the trees for days needed a name, so I gave it one: {PET_nameDef}. The others laughed, and then used it.
[grazer] There's a {KIND} on the far meadow every morning that hasn't moved on with the rest. I've called it {PET_nameDef}. It suits.
I named the wild one {PET_nameDef} today. Once a thing has a name you look for it.
[pokemon] The wild {KIND} that comes down to the fields at dusk is {PET_nameDef} now. I said it once and everyone took it up.
[pokemon,shiny] I named the shiny {PET_nameDef}. I can't stop looking at it.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef}. That's what I've called the wild {KIND} that watches us. It seemed unkind to go on calling it "it".

cheerful.li: Everyone's calling the wild {KIND} {PET_nameDef} now, and it was my idea!
